conditions.label: Non-alloyed steels and alloy steels, ~ HRc 35, ~ 1100 N/mm2 · flute length group 1

source.catalog: YG-1 4G Mills GMF19 recommended cutting conditions
source.notes: Chart prints RPM and inch/min, not SFM or chip load. SFM and chip load on the card are derived from those printed columns. Same printed column also says cast iron.
